#include <libproc.h>
#include <malloc/malloc.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <unistd.h>
static void *sample(void *ignored) {
 (void)ignored;
 unsigned logged=0;
 for(;;) {
  struct rusage_info_v4 info={0};
  if(proc_pid_rusage(getpid(),RUSAGE_INFO_V4,(rusage_info_t *)&info)==0 && info.ri_phys_footprint>1500000000ULL) {
   unsigned long long before=info.ri_phys_footprint;
   size_t released=malloc_zone_pressure_relief(NULL,0);
   proc_pid_rusage(getpid(),RUSAGE_INFO_V4,(rusage_info_t *)&info);
   if(released || logged<16) { fprintf(stderr,"allocator-sampler pid=%d released=%zu footprint_before=%llu footprint_after=%llu\n",getpid(),released,before,info.ri_phys_footprint);logged++; }
  }
  usleep(1000);
 }
 return NULL;
}
__attribute__((constructor)) static void loaded(void) {
 pthread_t worker;int result=pthread_create(&worker,NULL,sample,NULL);
 if(result==0) pthread_detach(worker);
 fprintf(stderr,"allocator-sampler loaded pid=%d thread_status=%d\n",getpid(),result);
}
